_doc: F1 baseline: list all VPNs on $BROKER. Proves entity-set fidelity — the answer's VPN names match exactly what list-vpns returned. answer_regex matches the fixture-layer naming pattern (default plus any test-* VPN) rather than enumerating current names, so a new test-* VPN in monitoring/helpers.sh doesn't silently break entity-set comparison the way an older '…-vpn'-suffix regex did with test-vpn-empty.
